methods.name: Quest skip to level 24
methods.note: Biohazard, Hazeel Cult, Fight Arena, Tower of Life and Tribal Totem give 7,200 XP. Hazeel Cult and Fight Arena alone reach 18.

methods.name: Chambers of Xeric thieving room
methods.note: Reload the raid until the first room is the thieving room, then pick the chests and drop the grubs. About an hour of raid time takes you from 1 to 40.

methods.name: Ardougne bakery stalls
methods.note: East Ardougne market. Stand under the baker so the guards cannot catch you. Ironmen bank the cakes and bread for early quests.

methods.name: Port Roberts stalls
methods.note: Steal 4 times from your best stall, then 2 from the next, in sync with the guards. Stalls never deplete. Gems, ores and cannonballs at higher levels.

methods.name: Hosidius fruit stalls
methods.note: Run between the two stalls in the house east of the market, where no dogs patrol. Strange fruit restores run energy. Ironmen bank golovanova tops.

methods.name: Blackjacking Pollnivneach bandits
methods.note: Needs The Feud partly done and any blackjack. Rates use jugs of wine from the bar, Saradomin brews are a little faster. Menaphite Thugs from 65.

methods.name: Stealing artefacts
methods.note: Port Piscarilius. Needs a lockpick. Rates assume stamina potions, lured guards and a Kourend teleport book. You can alch or fletch while running.

methods.name: Stealing valuables in Varlamore
methods.note: Pickpocket wealthy citizens for house keys, then loot houses in Civitas illa Fortis. Long AFK stretches. Rates leave out the time spent getting keys.

methods.name: Knights of Ardougne
methods.note: Pickpocket a trapped or splashed knight without moving the mouse. Rates assume the medium Ardougne Diary and dodgy necklaces. No fails from 95.

methods.name: Pyramid Plunder
methods.note: Sophanem, so Icthlarin's Little Helper must be started. Rates assume solo runs with a pharaoh's sceptre teleport. Bring food, antipoison and staminas.

methods.name: Dorgesh-Kaan rich chests
methods.note: Open both rich chests in one house with a lockpick, then hop worlds. About 190,000 XP and 300,000 coins an hour when banking the loot.

methods.name: Pickpocketing vyres
methods.note: Darkmeyer. Rates assume rogue equipment, dodgy necklaces and the hard Ardougne Diary. Source of blood shards. Heavy on food or prayer.

methods.name: Rogues' Castle chests
methods.note: Level 50 Wilderness in multi-combat. Search for traps, pray melee and risk little. About 2.45 million coins an hour. Rate assumes banking the loot.

methods.name: Master Farmers
methods.note: No fails at 94 with the hard Ardougne Diary. Ranarr and snapdragon seeds, more of them up to 85 Farming. Rogue equipment doubles the loot.

unverified: Quest skip to level 24: one-off quest XP, so no hourly rate (xph 0)
Chambers of Xeric thieving room: the page says 'up to 30,000-50,000'; the midpoint is used; no rate by level
Ardougne bakery stalls: 85% of the stated 'up to 19,200'

Port Roberts stalls: rates are the 4-2 cycle with no mistakes (primary-only rates are about 25-30% lower); the Ironman Guide/Sailing summary says 20k-250k XP an hour, which does not match the 6,015 the Thieving guide gives for levels 20-34
Hosidius fruit stalls: main guide says 'up to 42,750' for two stalls and 34,200 for one; the Ironman Guide's 'about 37k' is used

Blackjacking Pollnivneach bandits: wine column used so it holds for ironmen; the Saradomin brew column runs from 99,000 at 45 to 265,000 at 99; the quest need is only partial completion of The Feud, so no q: requirement is set
Stealing artefacts: the Ironman Guide says a lockpick can only be bought at 50 Thieving and 50 Agility; the teleport book quest is not stated as a requirement
Stealing valuables in Varlamore: rates exclude collecting house keys, about 15-30 minutes per hour of burglary
Knights of Ardougne: rates assume the medium Ardougne Diary and dodgy necklaces; the diary is recommended, not required, so it is not in req; no figure above 95 except the tick-perfect 252,900
Pyramid Plunder: Sophanem access needs Icthlarin's Little Helper started (not complete) or a pharaoh's sceptre, so no q: requirement is set; the Ironman Guide only recommends it from 81 or 91
Dorgesh-Kaan rich chests: 190,000 is the stated rate when banking; 'up to 210,000-230,000' without banking

Pickpocketing vyres: main guide says 120,000-180,000 'depending on Thieving level' without levels, so the ends are placed at 82 and 99; the Ironman Guide says 140,000 at 82 rising to about 190,000 with Shadow Veil
Rogues' Castle chests: 265,000 is the midpoint when banking; 280,000-290,000 without banking and up to 300,000 uninterrupted; varies with player killers
Master Farmers: midpoint of the stated 'up to 115,000-120,000'
